label: Late-episode D2 after a2 -> S2 (common), previous trial rewarded with a2 (a2 win-stay streak near episode end)
explanation: Fires only at D2, only when this trial chose a2, and only in the last ~15-20 trials of the episode (ep_trial 80-99; none before trial 80, about 90% of mass in 90-99; value-head output low). Nearly all mass (97%) is on steps where S2 is reached via the common transition, the previous trial was rewarded, and the previous choice was also a2 (stay). The predicate uses only variables observed at D2. Magnitude rises within the window as the episode end approaches and as a streak of rewarded a2->S2c trials continues (e.g. 0.32, 0.42, 0.53, 0.63, 0.72 across consecutive trials). It is weak (about 0.15-0.26) after a rare a2->S1 transition or after an unrewarded previous trial, and those weak cases make up most of the missed activations. It never fires at D1/GO, after a1, after a switch, or before trial 80. False positives are qualifying steps around trial 85-89 where the feature has not turned on yet. Dev F1 0.78, mass recall 0.93; adding prev_state != 1 gave a similar F1 (0.785), so I kept the simpler predicate.
